briefdescription.para: Stage bytes in the USB CDC Bulk IN transmit buffer.

simplesect.para: Port-decoupled staging contract: copies up to sizeof(cdc->tx_buf) (128 B) into cdc->tx_buf and sets cdc->tx_len. The platform USB ISR or polling loop transmits cdc->tx_buf on cdc->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon hardware completion to clear cdc->tx_len. Callers requiring atomic whole-frame rejection above 128 B should use SYN_Transport via syn_transport_from_usb_cdc().
SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if a staged packet is still pending.
